note: Colours for the world around the port (M14): the planet skirt beyond the desert, the outpost placeholder, and the sky in space. Read by src/systems/world/world_scenery.gd and src/systems/world/altitude_sky.gd.

dust.note: Issue #93: blowing sand round the camera (src/systems/look/dust_wind.gd). streaks: thin fast lines along the wind; puffs: slow soft clouds. box = half-width of the emitting box (m), height = its height above the ground, width/length = the quad (m), speed in m/s, alpha = opacity. The sand shader's wind_strength makes the matching sheets on the ground.
